description: Local-first ComfyUI workflows for images, video, audio and 3D. Partner models and uploads escalate to Comfy Cloud only when opted in.

interface.shortDescription: Local image, video, audio and 3D workflows
interface.longDescription: Generate images, video, audio, and 3D on your own GPU through the local ComfyUI MCP (comfy-mcp), and escalate to the hosted Comfy MCP (comfy-cloud) only for partner models and uploads.
